summary.text: Nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation is Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's arrangement, activated by her will when Limitless Demon Venerable reaches Heavenly Court's Central Great Hall.

claims.text: Limitless Demon Venerable lands in the formation and only manages to escape after destroying a hundred formations. The arrangement is not only this formation. Forgotten Dao Lake and Imperfection Regret Pavilion are also part of Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s meticulous set up.

Fang Yuan and the Southern Alliance attack Heavenly Court’s formation to stop the final batch of success dao marks from being sent to repair fate Gu. Chi Qu You identifies the defense as nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation. Legend says Star Constellation Immortal Venerable predicted Heavenly Court’s problem in the future and set it up, and that when Limitless Demon Venerable attacked Heavenly Court he entered this formation and only broke out after destroying a hundred formations. It is a giant compound formation that can mix and match using its nine sub-formations. When a formation is destroyed, Heavenly Court can set up a new one at the core area. If breaking speed is not faster than their setting-up speed, the defense is endless.
